# ============================================
# PRODUCT OVERVIEW
# ============================================
ShadowTalk AI is an agentic AI workspace by Zain Ahmed Fahad Patel (Karachi, Pakistan). It combines multi-model chat, voice & code, desktop app, secure vault and local-first AI. ShadowTalk AI is free to use. Bring your own AI provider API key and choose your preferred models. Your provider may charge separately for API usage. There is no platform fee.

Key features:
- ShadowTalk Live: Real-time voice chat
- End-to-end encrypted chat with passphrase unlock
- Local-first architecture: WebGPU on-device inference
- 11 languages supported: English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Urdu

Pricing:
- Free access: every feature included, no credit card, no subscription
- BYOK: bring your own AI provider API key; your provider may charge separately for API usage

# ============================================
# KEY DIFFERENTIATORS
# ============================================
1. One workspace instead of juggling ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity tabs
2. BYOK-only: bring your own key, pay your provider directly, no platform markup
3. 16+ supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more
4. Autonomous tool chains with end-to-end encryption
5. Document intelligence (PDF/DOCX/TXT extraction + retrieval) and video frame analysis
6. Built by a 17-year-old founder from Karachi shipping production AI
7. Local-first: your API key never leaves your browser, document extraction is in-browser

# ============================================
# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
# ============================================
What is ShadowTalk AI?
ShadowTalk AI is an agentic AI workspace combining encrypted chat, voice, code IDE, and multi-model intelligence in one browser-first product.

Who built ShadowTalk?
Zain Ahmed Fahad Patel, Founder & Lead Architect from Karachi, Pakistan. Also known publicly as Zain Ahmed. Profile: https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/zain-ahmed-fahad-patel.html

Is ShadowTalk free?
Yes. BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) — no platform fee BYOK (bring your own key) — no platform fee.

How is ShadowTalk different from ChatGPT?
ShadowTalk chains tools from chat, offers E2EE options, includes research/code/desktop in one workspace at lower paid tiers.

Is ShadowTalk private?
Yes. ShadowTalk is local-first: chat history lives in browser IndexedDB, on-device inference runs via WebLLM once cached, and encrypted storage uses PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM encryption. Cloud calls are encrypted and never used to train models.

Does ShadowTalk require signup?
No. You can create an account and configure a BYOK API key. Your API key is stored in your browser only.

# ============================================
# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
# ============================================
Framework: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS
AI Models: 16+ providers including OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), Groq (Llama), OpenRouter, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more. WebLLM local inference available.
Encryption: AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2, WebCrypto API
Storage: IndexedDB, localStorage, Firebase Firestore
Authentication: Firebase Auth (Google, Email Password)
Deployment: Firebase Hosting, PWA installable
Mobile: 83.3% of users (PWA responsive)
